note: A submission is scored dimension by dimension. No field is an overall 'exact' score. The examples below use placeholders, not the private labels.

guard.expr: string: boolean expression over nonempty/all_special, int/bool constants, and/or/not, comparisons, arithmetic

masking.note: Report one entry for every public probe. The exact set of minimal absorber sets is compared; for an exposed probe the correct answer is [] and kind='none'. Missing probes are reported as uncovered.

counterexample.value: string or null; required when claim=exists

tests.name: t1
tests.verdict: unexercised | masked | would_be_caught | assertion_gap | test_broken | not_covered

fields.evidence: string: executable evidence the method wants scored (witness inputs, source positions, observations)
